description: Save steps as a new test that Monity runs on a schedule and alerts on when it fails. Try the steps with try_test_steps first and save only steps that pass. The schedule is definition.settings.schedule (every 3 hours unless you say; no faster than the plan allows). It then counts as one of the account's monitors, and each run costs credits.

definition.description: The test's definition: { startUrl, steps[], variables?, settings? }. Read get_test_steps_guide first.

name.description: The test's name, as the person would call the journey: "Sign up", "Checkout with a card"

name: create_test
title: Create a test
